+# 원소31종과 정보 비겹침 시안
+
+2026-10-26 최신사용자요청:번호/이름과움직이는링이겹치는문제수정및다른디자인제시.후속으로1~31일모든원소31개를채팅에보여달라고요청했습니다. 먼저실제19차renderer의31개를정확하게보여주고원소정보를링밖에분리하는새배치3개를시각적으로제시합니다.19차는현재실행그대로유지하고이단계는제품코드/설정변경없이시안만만듭니다.
+
+현재19차는31개서로다른3D형상이아니라같은금속링모션에번호·기호·이름·영감팔레트가달라지는구성입니다.이점을사용자에게명시합니다.갤러리는원본src/visuals.py draw_orbit와ELEMENTS를사용하고원소입력만명시해Windows날짜를바꾸지않습니다.잔량은미조회미리보기이며실제계정값으로오해시키지않습니다.31종메타와PNG파일을대조하고4장각8/8/8/7로채팅에전부표시합니다.
+
+대체시안은설치Product Design ideate지침에따라세독립이미지로제시합니다.실제148정사각형/투명금속링/기존3D모션/날짜26Fe및SUIT를기준으로원소정보영역을물리적으로분리합니다.아래도크/위명패/옆정보열등정보위계가다른배치를비교합니다.생성이미지는정적시안이며실제EXE·모션확인으로표현하지않습니다.선택시점에제품구현/실제원소전체/비겹침픽셀검사를진행할수있게보존합니다.유료외부서비스나계정연결/다른채팅메시지전송없음.

+[Setup]
+AppId=CodexOrbit.Desktop
+AppName=Codex Orbit
+AppVersion=2.10.0
+AppPublisher=Codex Orbit
+DefaultDirName={localappdata}\Programs\CodexOrbit
+DefaultGroupName=Codex Orbit
+PrivilegesRequired=lowest
+ArchitecturesAllowed=x64compatible
+ArchitecturesInstallIn64BitMode=x64compatible
+MinVersion=10.0
+WizardStyle=modern dark includetitlebar
+SetupIconFile=..\assets\Orbit.ico
+WizardImageFile=..\assets\SetupBanner.bmp
+WizardSmallImageFile=..\assets\SetupSmall.bmp
+DisableProgramGroupPage=yes
+DisableDirPage=no
+OutputDir=..\배포
+OutputBaseFilename=CodexOrbit-Setup
+Compression=lzma2
+SolidCompression=yes
+UninstallDisplayIcon={app}\CodexOrbit.exe
+CloseApplications=yes
+SetupLogging=yes
+
+[Languages]
+Name: "english"; MessagesFile: "compiler:Default.isl"
+Name: "korean"; MessagesFile: "compiler:Languages\Korean.isl"
+
+[LangOptions]
+DialogFontName=SUIT
+WelcomeFontName=SUIT
+
+[CustomMessages]
+korean.DesktopShortcut=바탕화면 바로가기 만들기
+english.DesktopShortcut=Create a desktop shortcut
+korean.UserGuide=사용법
+english.UserGuide=User guide
+korean.GuideFile=사용법.md
+english.GuideFile=Usage.en.md
+korean.LaunchApp=Codex Orbit 실행
+english.LaunchApp=Launch Codex Orbit
+korean.FontError=내장 글꼴을 읽을 수 없습니다. 설치 파일을 다시 확인해 주세요.
+english.FontError=Could not load the bundled font. Please check the installer.
+
+[Tasks]
+Name: "desktopicon"; Description: "{cm:DesktopShortcut}"; Flags: unchecked
+
+[Files]
+Source: "..\배포\Usage.en.md"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\assets\SUIT-SemiBold.ttf"; DestDir: "{app}\assets"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\assets\SUIT-Medium.ttf"; DestDir: "{app}\assets"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\assets\SUIT-Regular.ttf"; DestDir: "{app}\assets"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\assets\NanumGothic-Bold.ttf"; DestDir: "{app}\assets"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\배포\CodexOrbit.exe"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\배포\사용법.md"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\배포\기본_지침.md"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\배포\연도별_월_테마.md"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\배포\연도별_월_테마.csv"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\배포\배포안내.md"; DestDir: "{app}"; Flags: ignoreversion
+Source: "..\배포\라이선스\*"; DestDir: "{app}\라이선스"; Flags: ignoreversion recursesubdirs
+
+[Icons]
+Name: "{group}\Codex Orbit"; Filename: "{app}\CodexOrbit.exe"
+Name: "{group}\{cm:UserGuide}"; Filename: "{app}\{cm:GuideFile}"
+Name: "{autodesktop}\Codex Orbit"; Filename: "{app}\CodexOrbit.exe"; Tasks: desktopicon
+
+[Run]
+Filename: "{app}\CodexOrbit.exe"; Description: "{cm:LaunchApp}"; Flags: nowait postinstall skipifsilent
+
+[Code]
+var
+  PrivateFontPath: String;
+
+function AddFontResourceExW(FileName: String; Flags: Cardinal; Reserved: Integer): Integer;
+  external 'AddFontResourceExW@gdi32.dll stdcall';
+function RemoveFontResourceExW(FileName: String; Flags: Cardinal; Reserved: Integer): Boolean;
+  external 'RemoveFontResourceExW@gdi32.dll stdcall';
+
+function InitializeSetup(): Boolean;
+begin
+  ExtractTemporaryFile('SUIT-SemiBold.ttf');
+  PrivateFontPath := ExpandConstant('{tmp}\SUIT-SemiBold.ttf');
+  Result := AddFontResourceExW(PrivateFontPath, $10, 0) > 0;
+  if not Result then
+    MsgBox(ExpandConstant('{cm:FontError}'), mbError, MB_OK);
+end;
+
+procedure InitializeWizard();
+begin
+  WizardForm.Font.Name := 'SUIT';
+  WizardForm.Font.Style := [fsBold];
+end;
+
+procedure DeinitializeSetup();
+begin
+  if PrivateFontPath <> '' then
+    RemoveFontResourceExW(PrivateFontPath, $10, 0);
+end;

+# Codex Orbit 2.10.0 · Quick guide
+
+[한국어](README.md) · [Usage guide](docs/Usage.en.md) · [Verification scope](docs/공개검증_26차.md) · [Revision history](VERSIONS.md) · [Revision 27](history/27/README.md) · [Font license](assets/SUIT-LICENSE.txt)
+
+Codex Orbit is a Windows desktop widget for daily 3D artwork, time, approximate local weather, account usage limits and local Codex model, reasoning and assignment notifications. It uses Python, PySide6 and ModernGL.
+
+Revision 27 restores publication of the locally verified revision 26 packages and updates documentation. Application version 2.10.0 remains unchanged. Release publication and remote file hashes are verified separately before completion.
+
+[Standalone EXE](https://github.com/PUVKID/Codex-Orbit/releases/download/v2.10.0/CodexOrbit.exe) · [Windows installer](https://github.com/PUVKID/Codex-Orbit/releases/download/v2.10.0/CodexOrbit-Setup.exe) · [Release, guides, licenses and checksums](https://github.com/PUVKID/Codex-Orbit/releases/tag/v2.10.0)
+
+Public source archives are GitHub's automatically generated archives; the private full development ZIP is not published.
+
+
+Run CodexOrbit.exe directly, or use CodexOrbit-Setup.exe to install it for the current Windows user. The installer supports Korean and English.
+
+Choose 한국어 or English in the detail window's top language selector, or in the desktop widget's right-click menu. The selection is saved. Drag the widget to move it; drag its right or bottom edge to resize it. Click it to open change history.
+
+Worldwide location and current temperature use the internet connection's approximate IP location. Windows Location Services are not required. Place names use Open-Meteo/GeoNames translations. If a translation or reliable match is unavailable, the original place name is shown. VPNs and mobile networks may point to a different region.
+
+The GPU renders an actual 3840×2160 source and downsamples it to the widget size before transfer. Pacing targets 240 fps; measured development-window generation was approximately 233–235 fps, so fixed 240 fps has not been achieved. Rendered frames, GUI paint counts and physical monitor refresh rate are different measurements.
+
+Usage bars show the account's remaining rate-limit percentage, not an exact token count. Chat titles, model IDs, role IDs and recorded public reasons remain unchanged when the interface language changes. Reasons not present in the source are not invented.
+
+The uninstaller preserves user instructions, backups and history. Included default instructions are not applied silently. Do not share your account credentials, local chat data or personal instruction files with the application package.
+
+Sources: https://open-meteo.com/ · https://www.geonames.org/ · https://ipwhois.io/
+
+
+## Rotation speed
+
+Use the Rotation speed slider near the top of the details window to select 0.25×–3×. Reset to 1× restores the default. You can also right-click the desktop widget and choose a speed preset. The choice is saved and restored on restart.
+
+Speed changes preserve the current animation phase. They affect the rings and sculpture only; clock, date, weather and usage updates retain their real-time schedules. Rotation speed and the 240 fps pacing target are separate controls of the animation.
+
+
+## Version 26 rotation speed
+
+Use the detail window slider or widget context menu to select 0.25–3× speed. The setting persists across restarts. Korean and English are supported. Further work toward fixed 240fps was withdrawn by the user. Recent measurements were approximately 227–230 generated frames/s and 214–229 unique Qt paints/s; these are separate from physical display refresh.

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..b35a67c2aa45b9b25c673dd1e4c70588b36bcab7
--- /dev/null
+++ b/archive/objects/51af8033f1ccbc7760a772185db1fccb6b9cc55a4cf6ca95c3562a32ba88c912.py
@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+"""유효 날짜 카탈로그와 월별·1월 매일의 실제 GPU 검토 시트를 만듭니다."""
+import argparse
+from dataclasses import asdict
+from datetime import date, datetime, timezone, timedelta
+import hashlib
+import io
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+import time
+import traceback
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path[:0]=[str(ROOT/'src'),str(ROOT.parent/'17차/work/render-deps')]
+from calendar_art import all_designs, design_for_date
+from calendar_renderer import CalendarRenderer, matrices, np
+from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
+from PySide6.QtCore import QBuffer, QIODevice
+
+
+def pil_image(image):
+    buffer=QBuffer(); buffer.open(QIODevice.OpenModeFlag.WriteOnly); image.save(buffer,'PNG')
+    result=Image.open(io.BytesIO(bytes(buffer.data()))).convert('RGBA'); buffer.close(); return result
+
+
+def catalog(folder):
+    rows=[]
+    for design in all_designs():
+        row=asdict(design); row['date']=design.date.isoformat(); rows.append(row)
+    assert len(rows)==27028 and len({r['key'] for r in rows})==27028 and len({r['seed'] for r in rows})==27028
+    content=json.dumps({'schema_version':1,'first_date':'2026-01-01','last_date':'2099-12-31',
+                       'date_timezone':'Asia/Seoul (UTC+09:00)','purpose':'날짜별 디자인 영감;실제 생물종·물리 구조 재현 아님',
+                       'geometry_rule_version':3,'count':len(rows),'designs':rows},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':'))
+    (folder/'2026-2099_날짜카탈로그.json').write_text(content,encoding='utf-8')
+    asset=ROOT/'assets/calendar-art'; asset.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    (asset/'catalog.json').write_text(content,encoding='utf-8')
+    return len(rows)
+
+
+def previews(folder):
+    renderer=CalendarRenderer(); records=[]; start=time.perf_counter()
+    font=ImageFont.truetype(str(ROOT/'assets/SUIT-SemiBold.ttf'),17)
+    try:
+        groups=(('12개월',[date(2026,m,15) for m in range(1,13)],4),('1월31일',[date(2026,1,d) for d in range(1,32)],7),
+                ('경계날짜',[date(2028,2,29),date(2099,12,31)],2))
+        for group,dates,columns in groups:
+            sheet=Image.new('RGB',(columns*220,((len(dates)+columns-1)//columns)*246),(15,22,38))
+            for index,value in enumerate(dates):
+                t=time.perf_counter(); image=renderer.render(value,0); raw=pil_image(image)
+                assert raw.getpixel((0,0))[3]==0
+                name=value.isoformat()+'.png'; image.save(str(folder/name))
+                digest=hashlib.sha256()
+                for (v,ix),_,_,_ in renderer.parts[:-2]:
+                    assert np.isfinite(v).all() and int(ix.max())<len(v)
+                    assert np.abs(np.linalg.norm(v[:,3:],axis=1)-1).max()<1e-5
+                    digest.update(v.tobytes()); digest.update(ix.tobytes())
+                records.append({'date':value.isoformat(),'title':design_for_date(value).title,'parts':len(renderer.parts),
+                                'geometry_sha256':digest.hexdigest(),'seconds':time.perf_counter()-t,'bbox':raw.getbbox()})
+                small=raw.convert('RGBa').resize((216,216),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS).convert('RGBA')
+                x=index%columns*220; y=index//columns*246; background=Image.new('RGBA',(216,216),(15,22,38,255)); background.alpha_composite(small)
+                sheet.paste(background.convert('RGB'),(x+2,y)); ImageDraw.Draw(sheet).text((x+8,y+219),f'{value.month:02d}/{value.day:02d}  {design_for_date(value).title}',font=font,fill=(228,234,246))
+            sheet.save(folder/(group+'_접촉시트.jpg'),quality=95)
+        january=[r for r in records if r['date'].startswith('2026-01-')]
+        assert len({r['geometry_sha256'] for r in january})==31
+        for first,second in ((date(2027,8,29),date(2036,8,29)),(date(2055,3,24),date(2068,3,24))):
+            hashes=[]
+            for value in (first,second):
+                renderer.set_date(value); digest=hashlib.sha256()
+                for (v,ix),_,_,_ in renderer.parts[:-2]:digest.update(v.tobytes()); digest.update(ix.tobytes())
+                hashes.append(digest.hexdigest())
+            assert hashes[0]!=hashes[1], '기존 충돌 날짜의 실제 메시가 같습니다.'
+            records.append({'year_pair':[first.isoformat(),second.isoformat()],'geometry_hashes':hashes})
+        timings=[]
+        for index in range(60):
+            t=time.perf_counter(); renderer.render(date(2026,1,15),index/30); timings.append(time.perf_counter()-t)
+        epsilon=.0001
+        loop_position=max(float(np.max(np.abs(a-b))) for a,b in zip(matrices(0),matrices(12)))
+        loop_velocity=max(float(np.max(np.abs((a-b)/(2*epsilon)-(c-d)/(2*epsilon)))) for a,b,c,d in zip(matrices(epsilon),matrices(-epsilon),matrices(12+epsilon),matrices(12-epsilon)))
+        report={'renderer':renderer.ctx.info['GL_RENDERER'],'opengl':renderer.ctx.info['GL_VERSION'],'frames':records,
+                'seconds':time.perf_counter()-start,'steady_render_ms_mean':sum(timings[1:])/59*1000,'steady_render_ms_max':max(timings[1:])*1000,
+                'loop_matrix_max_error':loop_position,'loop_velocity_max_error':loop_velocity,'catalog_video_count':0,
+                'external_meshes':False,'external_hdri':False,'runtime':'현재날짜1모델/1GPU컨텍스트/384RGBA'}
+        (folder/'렌더_결과.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
+        print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='frames'},ensure_ascii=False))
+    finally:renderer.close()
+
+
+def main():
+    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(); parser.add_argument('--output',type=Path,required=True); args=parser.parse_args()
+    args.output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+    print(json.dumps({'catalog':catalog(args.output)}),flush=True); previews(args.output)
+
+
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    try:main()
+    except Exception:
+        state=json.loads((ROOT/'.codex/routing-state/df07fc65fbd813b9b2f33268.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
+        folder=ROOT/'evidence/달력3D22'; folder.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
+        failure={'kst':datetime.now(timezone(timedelta(hours=9))).isoformat(),'session':state['session_id'],'task':state['task_id'],
+                 'argv':sys.orig_argv,'cwd':str(Path.cwd()),'exit_code':1,'error':traceback.format_exc(),'changed':'새 달력3D 파일만',
+                 'repair_used':state['repair_used'],'input_fix_used':state['input_fix_used']}
+        (folder/f'failure-{time.time_ns()}.json').write_text(json.dumps(failure,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8');raise

@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+# 회전 속도와 초당240프레임 수정 계획
+
+목표: 사용자가 회전 속도를 조절하며 4K 렌더의 실제 생성·GUI 갱신을 초당240프레임에 맞춥니다. 기존 25차와 실패 이력을 보존합니다.
+
+현재 확인: 25차는3840×2160 렌더와240Hz 목표를 사용하지만 실창 고유프레임은233~235fps였습니다. 고해상도 타이머를 이미 사용하며 다음 슬롯 계산은 지연된 슬롯을 즉시 건너뜁니다. 이 계산이 현재 미달의 주원인인지는 새 계측으로 확인합니다. 모니터59.973Hz 관측은 물리 표시율이며 소프트웨어 프레임과 구분합니다.
+
+선택: 기존 PySide6·ModernGL·금속3링과 SUIT 글꼴 예외를 유지합니다. 전체 GUI 엔진 교체 대신 병목을 계측하고 확인된 지점만 수정합니다. 프레임 수를 늘려 회전 자체를 빨리 하는 방식은 사용자의 속도 조절과 충돌하므로 선택하지 않습니다. 범위0.25~3.0배·기본1배는 부모의 구현 결정입니다. 사용자는 이전 대화에서 자율 구현을 요청했으므로 추가 디자인 승인 질문을 반복하지 않습니다.
+
+- [ ] 자료 읽기·25차 상태7/1/vf0를26차에 연속 보존, 같은 task 재개.
+- [ ] UI 담당: app.py/i18n.py/test_motion_speed_ui.py에 속도 슬라이더와 우클릭 속도 선택, 저장·복원·한영 전환·입력경계 RED→구현→국소검사. 인터페이스 set_calendar_motion_speed(value: float), 유효값0.25~3.0. 호출 실패는 숨기지 않습니다.
+- [ ] 렌더 담당: calendar_motion.py/frame_pacing.py 및 해당 새 검사, work/evidence 진단. 동일 실창 측정으로 생성·고유paint·CPU·실제간격·최대멈춤을 분리하고 원인 확인 뒤에만 최소 수리. 속도 변경은 각도 점프 없이 가상 시간의 기울기만 바꿉니다. 실제 시각·날짜·날씨·잔량 갱신은 속도 영향을 받지 않습니다.
+- [ ] 기존 4K/금속재질/MSAA4/전달크기/날짜별 모티프/3링 독립주기를 유지. 전역 타이머·전원·GPU·모니터 설정을 변경하지 않습니다. 무제한 바쁜대기·무제한 큐·카운트 조작을 사용하지 않습니다.
+- [ ] 구현자는 원문·RED·한계·실측을 반환하고 소스를 동결. 별도 verifier Sol/high가 독립 검증. 기존 기능30초/소스15초/총45초 기준 유지.
+- [ ] 단일EXE·설치형 재제작과 기존6단계 실실행, 사용자 자료 보존·운영 교체·감시 재개 확인.
+- [ ] GitHub에 검증된26차와 모든 확인 가능한 차수의 README/전체파일 비교·텍스트diff·바이너리 크기와해시 링크를 반영하고 원격 일치·표시 확인. 개인자료 제외. 실제240미달이면 완료로 숨기지 않습니다.
+
+검토 초점: 속도 변경 시 위상 점프, NaN·무한대·bool·범위 밖 설정, 숨김·재표시 시 CPU 사용과 작업자 수명, 한영 변경 시 속도 유실, 지연 뒤 폭주·GUI 응답 중단.
